name: claudemanager
description: Piloter les conversations Claude de l'extension VSCode depuis un agent, sans jamais voler le focus.

scripts.package:vscode: npm run build:vscode && npm run artifacts:dir && cd packages/vscode && vsce package --no-dependencies --out ../../artifacts/
scripts.package:cli: npm run build:cli && npm run artifacts:dir && npm pack --workspace @claudemanager/cli --pack-destination artifacts
scripts.package:all: npm run artifacts:clean && npm run package:vscode && npm run package:cli
scripts.verify:packaging: npm run package:all && vitest run --config vitest.packaging.config.ts
scripts.test:integration: npm run build:vscode && npm run build:integration && node tests/integration/dist/tests/integration/src/runTests.js
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test:coverage
